name: assay-truth-graph
description: Ranked, governed, cited GTM context for your agents, on one living source of truth.

interface.shortDescription: Ground your agents in governed company truth.
interface.longDescription: Most MCPs are a vector search with a logo. Ours is a context engine. Assay keeps one living source of truth current, sourced, and approved, and this plugin hands that truth to Codex: ranked, cited facts shaped for the caller, provenance on every claim, confidentiality enforced server-side. Then your agents do the work, not just the lookup, with full parity to the Assay app: collateral, AI-search and GEO briefs, readiness sims, pre-call briefs, and governed writes back into the graph. Writes are dry-run by default and mint a single-use plan token that has to be confirmed. Pricing, policy, proof, and identity stay off limits to autonomous mutation. Change a fact once and every page, deck, and agent that referenced it updates inside 48 hours.
defaultPrompt: Check this draft against our approved claims.
